Orchestration — 10 terminal worker jobs

delegate/sub-agent tool unavailable on this pod → fallback: 10 parallel terminal worker jobs. Each = `setsid nohup timeout -k 30 18000 python3 /tmp/orch/worker.py SAn` (own process group, hard 5 h cap) reading its scoped brief (/tmp/orch/briefs/SAn.json) and executing queued steps (bash/python/Playwright via a process-group wrapper with a hard per-step cap), ISO-8601 UTC logs. Workers are scripted jobs, not LLM agents; the lead authored the steps, generated/judged images through the OnDemand MCP plugins and made all code decisions.
